units.source_text: 出乎意外的，是那个老侍女弁君出来代替大女公子应对了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the old gentlewoman Ben no Kimi came out and answered in place of the elder princess.

units.source_text: 她对薰君讲了昔日今时许多可悲的事实。

en.t: She told Lord Kaoru many sorrowful facts about both the past and the present.

units.source_text: 只因此人亲见又详悉那桩可惊可悲之事，故虽然形容异常衰老，薰君并不讨厌，亲切地与她共话。

en.t: Because she had personally witnessed that shocking and sorrowful affair and knew it in detail, Kaoru did not dislike her despite her extremely aged appearance, and spoke with her kindly.

units.source_text: 对她说道：“我在孩提之时，即遭六条院先父之丧，深感人生于世虚幻可悲。

en.t: He said to her, “When I was still a child, I suffered the loss of my late father, the Rokujo-in, and deeply felt how fleeting and sorrowful human life is.

units.source_text: 故后来年龄渐增，长大成人，对于爵禄富厚，全然不感兴趣。

en.t: For that reason, as I grew older and reached adulthood, I felt no interest at all in rank, stipends, wealth, or prosperity.

units.source_text: 惟有像这里的亲王那样的闲居静修的生涯，深得我心之所好。

en.t: Only a life of quiet retirement and spiritual discipline, like that of the prince here, truly suited my heart.

units.source_text: 如今眼见亲王亦已化为乌有，愈觉人世之可悲，急欲抛弃此无常之世，遁入空门。

en.t: Now that I have seen even the prince vanish into nothing, I feel the sorrow of this world all the more and urgently wish to abandon this impermanent life and enter the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 只因亲王这两位遗眷孤苦无依，成了我的羁绊。

en.t: Only the prince's two bereaved daughters, lonely and without anyone to rely on, have become my bond to this world.

units.source_text: 我说这话，太无礼了。

en.t: It is terribly rude of me to say such a thing.

units.source_text: 但我一定不负亲王遗嘱，只要我命生存于世，自当竭诚效劳。

en.t: But I will certainly not betray the prince's last wishes, and as long as I remain alive in this world, I shall serve them with all my heart.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，但我自从听你说了那件意想不到的旧事之后，越发不欲寄迹在这尘世之中了。”

en.t: Even so, ever since I heard from you about that unexpected matter from the past, I have wished all the more not to remain in this dusty world.”

units.source_text: 他边哭边说。

en.t: He said this while weeping.

units.source_text: 弁君更加哭得厉害，话也说不出来。

en.t: Ben no Kimi wept even more intensely and could not get any words out.

units.source_text: 薰君的相貌竟与柏木一般无二。

en.t: Lord Kaoru's appearance was in fact exactly like Kashiwagi's.

units.source_text: 弁君看了，连久已忘记了的旧事也回忆起来，因此加倍悲伤，一句话也不说，只管吞声饮泣。

en.t: Seeing him, Ben no Kimi remembered even old events she had long forgotten, and her grief redoubled; without saying a word, she only stifled her voice and sobbed.

units.source_text: 这老侍女是柏木大纳言的乳母的女儿。

en.t: This old gentlewoman was the daughter of the nurse of Kashiwagi, the Major Counselor.

units.source_text: 她的父亲是两女公子的母舅，官至左中弁而身亡。

en.t: Her father was the maternal uncle of the two princesses, and he died after rising to the office of Sachu-ben.

units.source_text: 她多年流寓远国，回京之时，两女公子的母亲也已亡故。

en.t: She had spent many years living away in a distant province, and when she returned to the capital, the mother of the two princesses had already died.

units.source_text: 对柏木大纳言家又已生疏，八亲王便收留了她。

en.t: She had also grown distant from the household of Kashiwagi the Major Counselor, so the Eighth Prince took her in.

units.source_text: 此人出身并不高贵，而且惯当宫女。

en.t: This woman was not of especially noble birth, but she was accustomed to service at court.

units.source_text: 但八亲王认为她不是无知无识的女子，就叫她服侍两女公子。

en.t: But the Eighth Prince judged that she was not an ignorant woman, and so he had her attend upon the two princesses.

units.source_text: 关于柏木的秘密，她对于多年来朝夕相见而无话不说的两女公子，也不曾泄露一句话，一直隐藏在心里。

en.t: As for the secret concerning Kashiwagi, she had not revealed a single word of it even to the two princesses, whom she had seen morning and evening for many years and to whom she spoke of everything, but had kept it hidden in her heart all along.

units.source_text: 但薰中纳言推想：老婆子多嘴饶舌，不问自说，乃世间常例。

en.t: But Kaoru, now a Middle Counselor, thought to himself that old women were usually talkative and would speak even when no one asked them.

units.source_text: 这弁君即使不会轻易地向一般人宣传，但对这两位含羞忍性、谨慎小心的女公子，说不定已经说过了。

en.t: Even if this Ben no Kimi would not lightly spread it among ordinary people, she might already have told these two modest, patient, and cautious princesses.

units.source_text: 便觉可耻亦复可恨。

en.t: The thought made him feel both ashamed and resentful.

units.source_text: 他之所以不肯放弃而企图亲近她们，多半是为了想保守这秘密之故吧。

en.t: His refusal to give up and his attempt to draw close to them were probably mostly because he wanted to protect this secret.
